title: Adjustment Total
description: A signed cost breakdown entry on an adjustment. Unlike a receipt Total, the amount is a delta against the order: negative for money returned to the buyer (refunds, credits), positive for additional charges (exchanges), in every category. A refunded `subtotal`, `fulfillment`, or `tax` is negative; a clawed-back `discount` is positive.

type.description: Cost category. Well-known values: subtotal, items_discount, discount, fulfillment, tax, fee, total. Businesses MAY use additional values.

display_text.description: Text to display against the amount (e.g., 'Shipping refund').
